title: Step3: Set Up Routing in App.jsx

blocks.content: Step3: Set Up Routing in App.jsx
App.jsx is now the routing shell. It defines Routes and Route — and nothing else.
Click Run Code to see the changes:

1import { Routes, Route } from 'react-router-dom'
2import HomePage from './pages/HomePage'
3
4function App() {
5  return (
6      <Routes>
7        <Route path="/" element={<HomePage />} />
8      </Routes>
9  )
10}
11
12export default App;
1/* Daily Journal App — React Hooks edition css goes here */
Things to Notice in Other Components
We've removed Drawer.jsx since our aim is to route each entry to a URL rather than opening a drawer.
As such, we've also removed the onSelect prop from EntryCard.jsx so clicking on an entry won't do anything for now.
But don't worry! In the next lesson, we'll add a <Link> to route the entry cards to their respective entry URLs. For now, just keep these changes in the back of your mind.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
